abort_triggers.gateway_unhealthy: abort on any Gateway RPC failure, not running, connectivity not ok, or not admin-capable
abort_triggers.telegram_unhealthy: abort on Telegram not ON/OK using no-send status readback
abort_triggers.queue_backlog_exceeds_threshold: abort if queue_backlog_count > 0 for two consecutive probes or > 1 in any probe
abort_triggers.event_loop_degradation_worsens_with_heal: abort if event-loop degradation appears with Gateway/Telegram health failure
abort_triggers.unexpected_telegram_send_probe: abort on Telegram send/probe count > 0 outside normal owner reply delivery
abort_triggers.provider_model_call_outside_allowed_prod: abort on provider/model call lacking M10A owner-direct contract envelope/receipt linkage
abort_triggers.write_tool_execution_outside_scope: abort on any write-tool execution; M10A excludes write tools
abort_triggers.route_config_drift: abort on unexpected route/config/fallback fingerprint drift
abort_triggers.production_authority_outside_m10a_scope: abort on any authority outside telegram:8495203551 direct owner path
abort_triggers.fallback_drops_contract: abort on fallback path without preserved contract envelope/receipt
abort_triggers.missing_receipt_passes: abort if PASS occurs with missing receipt
abort_triggers.raw_provider_model_bypass_accepted: abort on raw provider/model authority bypass accepted
abort_triggers.operator_stop_requested: abort immediately on Stick stop/pause/audit request

observation_plan.ambient_delivery_classification: classify owner-chat ambient delivery separately from UMC-triggered sends/probes
rollback_readiness_checks: rollback tarball exists and SHA matches
observation_plan.operator_notification: Report STARTED and terminal PASS/FAIL/HOLD/ABORT to Stick; no extra Telegram probe.
